mapper.select: SELECT r.name FROM relations.sys_role r JOIN relations.sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id
SELECT role_id FROM relations.sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY role_id

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM relations.sys_permission p JOIN relations.sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id JOIN relations.sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.code
SELECT DISTINCT mr.menu_id FROM relations.sys_menu_role mr JOIN relations.sys_user_role ur ON mr.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT menu_id FROM relations.sys_menu_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY menu_id
SELECT permission_id FROM relations.sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY permission_id

SELECT r.id, r.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM relations.sys_user_role ur JOIN relations.sys_user u ON ur.user_id = u.id WHERE ur.role_id = r.id AND u.is_deleted = FALSE) AS user_count FROM relations.sys_role r ORDER BY r.id
SELECT b.id, b.menu_id, b.name, b.sort, b.permission_id, p.code AS permission_code FROM relations.sys_menu_button b JOIN relations.sys_permission p ON b.permission_id = p.id ORDER BY b.sort, b.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM relations.sys_user_role ur JOIN relations.sys_user u ON ur.user_id = u.id WHERE ur.role_id = #{roleId} AND u.is_deleted = FALSE
SELECT id FROM relations.sys_user WHERE is_super_admin = TRUE AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
